voice.reference_text: Let me be blunt about this brow pencil: I will absolutely repurchase, mainly because the ingredient list is solid.
voice.target_lufs_note: -16 LUFS is the usual target for spoken-word content. Set on every voice so they can be cut together without one jumping out: before this, sofia-vargas sat at -15.7 and the GPT-SoVITS voices at -21.6 to -23.9, an 8.2 dB spread.
